map.一次性缴清的纯保费 使用指南: Net single premium paid in one lump sum guide
map.输入死亡率、利率与死亡给付金额，按现值求和计算一次性缴清的净趸缴纯保费（NSP）: Enter mortality, interest rate and death benefit amount and sum the present values to compute the net single premium (NSP) paid in one lump sum, as the single-premium pricing basis for term or whole life insurance.
map.在给定死亡率与利率下，死亡给付的现值即净趸缴保费。: Under given mortality and interest rates, the present value of the death benefit is the net single premium.
map.把未来各年给付按预定利率折现求和，得趸缴净保费。: Discount each future year's benefit at the assumed interest rate and sum them to get the net single premium.
map.对比不同预定利率下的净单保费。: Compare net single premiums under different assumed interest rates.
map.保额 100 万、年死亡率 1%、预定利率 3%、10 年: Insured amount 1M, mortality 1%, assumed rate 3%, 10 years
map.：按本页死亡给付模型逐年递推：v=1÷1.03=0.970874；第 1 年死亡: ：Under this page's death-benefit model, recursing year by year: v = 1÷1.03 = 0.970874. Year 1 death probability 1%, discounted payout 1,000,000×0.970874×1% = 9,708.74; year 2 survival 99%, death probability 0.99%, discounted payout 9,331.70; year 10 survival 91.35%, death probability 0.9135%, discounted payout 6,797.43. Summing the ten years gives NSP ≈ 81,763.70, i.e. 8.18% of the sum insured, while 90.44% of the cohort is still alive at the end of the term (no payout for them, so it is not counted in the net single premium). For comparison, a guaranteed 1,000,000 per year is an annuity-due with ä₁₀@3% ≈ 8.530 and a present value of about 8.53 million — that is a certain annuity without mortality, a different object from this page's death-benefit model, and the two cannot be swapped.
map.由需求与保费变动率求弹性: Compute elasticity from the rates of change in demand and premium
map.由期望损失与暴露单位求纯费率: Compute the pure premium rate from expected loss and exposure units
map.净单保费含费用吗？: Does the net single premium include expenses?
map.不含。它是纯风险现值，毛保费还要乘 (1+附加费率) 并考虑缴费方式。: No. It is the net present value of risk only; the gross premium still has to be multiplied by (1 + loading rate) and adjusted for the payment mode.
map.净单保费和趸缴保费差多少？: How much do the net single premium and the single premium differ?
map.净单保费等于纯风险现值，趸缴保费等于净单加费用附加（一次性）。健康体趸缴通常比分: The net single premium equals the present value of pure risk, while the single premium equals the net single premium plus an expense loading (paid once). For healthy lives the single premium is typically 15%-30% higher than the installment net single premium present value; the difference is expenses and profit margin.
